title: Kyiv: Casualties reported
description: Update: Russia attacks Kyiv for over 20 hours in single day. Air raid sirens blared over Kyiv for 20 hours and 44 minutes on Sept. 30, one of the longest sustained attacks the capital has faced since the start of the full-scale war. The strikes killed three people and injured seven others in Kyiv. In the surrounding region, a child was killed and one person injured.
